items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I stood on the corner and listened to Joe Oliver and the bands, you know, in the district.

ctx.x: way ahead each time. All right. I can hear you say something about the hearing and noise. It's a new microphone and it's possible if my contacts are bad, I'll go in there and see how they are. We may have to start over. But, go ahead with the story.

Well, you know, I was studying violin and the teacher didn't want us to play anything but the classical music, but I'd follow like all the other kids. I'd follow the bands down the street and once in a while sneak in the district, you know, with my long pants on and listen to them. I stood on the corner and listened to Joe Oliver and the bands, you know, in the district.
Is that so? Yeah, I sneaked in there. Where'd you hear Joe play? Do you remember that?
